name: bao-moi-react
description: Báo Mới - Ứng dụng tin tức thời sự

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "AUTH,POSTS,CATEGORIES,TAGS,COMMENTS,API" --prefix "{name}" --prefix-colors "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgRed.bold,bgWhite.bold" "cd backend/services/auth-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/posts-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/categories-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/tags-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/comments-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/api-gateway && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && set PORT=3004 && set HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 && npm run dev
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "FRONTEND,AUTH,POSTS,CATEGORIES,TAGS,COMMENTS,API" --prefix "{name}" --prefix-colors "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgRed.bold,bgWhite.bold,bgGray.bold" "npm run dev:frontend" "cd backend/services/auth-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/posts-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/categories-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/tags-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/comments-service && npm run dev" "cd backend/services/api-gateway && npm run dev"
